subject: Request: 90-day pilot extension + targeted usage credit for Pelago Health
messages:
From: Eric Summers <eric@pelago.health>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: partnerships@pelago.health; procurement@pelago.health
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot usage spike — ask for extension and credit

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick turn on the sandbox last month. We’ve been running two key workflows against the model and have seen a ~4x token consumption spike vs. our original estimate (attached: Pelago_Usage_Q1.csv).

We’re near the end of our 30-day pilot and the team is asking for two things so we can validate the go-live case properly:

- A 90-day extension of the pilot window (to run the full clinical transcript set).
- A one-time targeted usage credit to cover the overage while we complete evaluation (~$6k estimated).

If you can route this to the right approval or let us know the expected timeline, that would help procurement and our data governance team finalize the POC sign-off.

Best,
Eric
Director of Product
Pelago Health

Attachments: Pelago_Usage_Q1.csv (CSV, 34KB)

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot usage spike — ask for extension and credit

Marissa / Aditya — forwarding Pelago’s ask. They’ve overshot tokens and want a 90-day stretch + a one-time credit to avoid a hard stop while procurement locks in the contract.

Quick context: Pelago is a high-priority prospect in health tech (clinical notes ingestion). We’ve been doing a single-model proof; their usage went up when they started streaming batch imports. They’re actively moving procurement but need runway.

Suggested approach:
- Marissa, can you propose a bridging credit (one-time) sized to cover the overage with clear conditions (timeboxed, non-recurring)?
- Aditya, if we grant an extension, what limits do we need to set on peak throughput to protect shared capacity?

I’ll summarize for Markus and request exec sign-off if numbers look reasonable.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot usage spike — ask for extension and credit

Vanessa — thanks for the ping. Reviewed their usage file: the spike correlates to the batch ingest job they ran on 3/22 and looks temporary, not sustained.

Proposal:
- One-time credit equal to 75% of the calculated overage ($4,500) applied to the pilot account.
- 60-day extension (not 90) to keep the opportunity tight and ensure they commit to a follow-up evaluation milestone.
- Require a short mutual action plan (MAP) with target deliverables at 30 and 60 days, and a requirement for procurement to confirm intent-to-purchase by the day-45 checkpoint.

Rationale: 60 days gives them enough runway to complete clinical validations while limiting our open exposure. If they need 90 days, we can escalate.

I’ll draft the MAP language once you approve the numbers.

— Marissa
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot usage spike — ask for extension and credit

Looping in infra concerns. If we extend and provide a credit we should attach short-term guardrails:

- Burst cap: 2x their current sustained rate (automatic throttling above this).
- Prefetch caching disabled for the pilot account for the extension window to avoid cross-account impact.
- Observability: we’ll add a dedicated dashboard for Pelago and schedule a weekly 30-min check-in for the next 8 weeks.

These controls are conservative and should be acceptable to the customer — they preserve our capacity while letting Pelago finish validation.

Aditya
Head of Dedicated Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Exec approval request: Pelago — 60-day extension + $4,500 credit (one-time)

Markus — requesting exec sign-off for a one-time concession to close Pelago:

Summary:
- Customer: Pelago Health (deal D-2027-0421-PELAGO)
- Ask: 60-day extension to pilot; one-time credit $4,500 to cover usage spike
- Controls: burst cap at 2x sustained rate; caching disabled; weekly ops review added
- Goal: complete clinical validation and secure PO/commit within the extension window

Why approve: Pelago is a strategic early-health customer and the footprint they’re evaluating maps to potential mid-six-figure ARR in year 1 if they convert. The requested credit is modest relative to potential lifetime value. We also have mitigations to protect capacity.

If you approve, I’ll send a short MAP and a revised SOW (attached) for their signature.

Thanks,
Vanessa

From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: Pelago — 60-day extension + $4,500 credit (one-time)

Vanessa / team — approved.

Conditions:
1) Apply the $4,500 as a one-time credit to the pilot account; credit expires if Pelago hasn’t signed the updated SOW within 60 days.
2) Enable the burst cap and caching controls immediately upon extension activation.
3) Schedule the 30- and 60-day MAP reviews; if no procurement commitment at day-45, escalate to me for review.

Marissa — please send the MAP + revised SOW and copy procurement language for enforcement.

Markus K.
VP Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
